# Di-experten: ”Köp på ryktet och sälj på nyheten”

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-30  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts talk about Mikael Wilenius's statistic that the Swedish market has returned 2.7% on average in the roughly 20 trading days before the first large-cap reports, and one host says he will move cash into equity funds because of it. Ulf Pettersson argues that earnings drive the market more than interest rates. He sees a strong investment boom from defence, AI and the energy transition, but warns that rate hikes could eventually choke the economy. In the Q3 large-cap review, beaten-down stocks such as Mips, Troax, Truecaller and Yubico rebounded on strong half-year reports, while Fenix Outdoor and AAK were weak.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ FOI-B — Fenix Outdoor | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Down 30% in Q3 after another very weak Fjällräven report; down 75% from peak and has problems.

#### Reasoning

Ulf Pettersson describes repeated weak reports from Fjällräven and says he does not understand what management is doing. The stock is down 75% from its peak and still falling. He also says losers can turn around, but he gives no turnaround case for Fenix, so the view is negative for now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a report shows Fjällräven sales recovering
- if management presents a credible turnaround plan

> *"Det var ännu en jättesvag rapport från Fjällräven. Jag vet inte riktigt vad de håller på med där. Det har ju gått ner 75 procent sen toppen och har problem."*

---

### 🟠 AAK — AAK | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Weak half-year report, troublesome cash flow, and pressure over its choice of reported figures despite a history of high valuation.

#### Reasoning

Ulf says AAK's half-year report was on the weak side with troublesome cash flow, and that a history of high valuation means little is needed to hurt the stock. The questions about which figures it presents add risk. No explicit sell call was made, so the view is a cautious watch ahead of the Q3 report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q3 report shows cash flow improving
- if the questions about its reported figures are resolved

> *"AAK däremot var åt det svaga hållet och kassaflödet var besvärligt."*
